actual_game_ui: No supported patron-sanctum runtime content; these are 2D source concepts, not 3D prop deliveries.

cells.subject: aster-tuning-fork
cells.notes: Unequal bronze prongs, wire bridge and connected slate foot give a clear instrument silhouette; the wire recedes at compact size.

cells.subject: neris-tide-balance
cells.notes: Unequal shell bowls, curved load-bearing beam and central pivot read as a balance rather than a wave symbol. Broad aqua meniscus keeps water distinct from the ceramic rim.

cells.subject: vesta-coal-tongs
cells.notes: The pivot and tool contour are readable, but the coal appears supported by only the lower jaw while the other jaw misses it; suspended action is structurally ambiguous. Retain this concept on hold, no reroll or runtime suitability claimed.

cells.subject: isen-stillness-chime
cells.notes: Unequal ceramic slabs and suspended cords read clearly at native size. At 80px the thin cords recede, though the chime frame remains recognizable.

cells.subject: nyra-witness-mirror
cells.notes: Tilted oval, dark reflection bands, thin silver bevel and split stone support distinguish a physical mirror from the existing eye mark. Quiet plum planes remain legible.

aesthetic_acceptance: Four optional candidates, one structural hold. User acceptance pending. No reroll.
